text_block_list.text:
One afternoon, as I head to the cafeteria
to eat...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: CRACK!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Oh NOOOOO! My tea cup has cracked
agaaaain!
text_block_list.name: Каваками Принцесс

text_block_list.text:
C-calm down. It can still hold tea, can't
it?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер

text_block_list.text:
But this is the fifth one! There's no way
I'll be
ready in time for the tea party!
text_block_list.name: Каваками Принцесс

text_block_list.text: Nngh... At this rate... At this rate...
text_block_list.name: Каваками Принцесс

text_block_list.text:
My elegant tea party with King is but a
distant
dream!
text_block_list.name: Каваками Принцесс

text_block_list.text:
Look, everyone has to start somewhere. I
used to
break stuff all the time too.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер

text_block_list.text:
I remember when I cried over a stain on
my skirt,
and Ryan had to console me.
Hehe.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер

text_block_list.text:
See? Give it another go. I'll help you till
you get it
right.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер

text_block_list.text:
After all, I know what it's like to want to
get
closer to someone.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер

text_block_list.text: Oh, Dober!
text_block_list.name: Каваками Принцесс

text_block_list.text:
Yes, yes! Please teach me the rules of
etiquette!
Make a dame of the ditz
before you!
text_block_list.name: Каваками Принцесс

text_block_list.text:
Мэдзиро Добер continues her tea
etiquette lesson.
However...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: CRUMBLE!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Whaaaaat?! I crushed my scooooone?!
text_block_list.name: Каваками Принцесс

text_block_list.text:
D-don't sweat it! Let's save the snacks
for later
and move on to pouring tea...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер

text_block_list.text: CRACK!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: AAAAGH! The teapot handle broke off!
text_block_list.name: Каваками Принцесс

text_block_list.text:
W-we'll just glue it back on! Once it's
repaired,
we'll try again...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер

text_block_list.text:
Despite their valiant efforts, time passes
without
much progress...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Sniff... I can't believe it's already night, and I still can't even pour a simple cup of tea!
text_block_list.name: Каваками Принцесс

text_block_list.text:
This is terrible. Absolutely dreadful. I
trained hard
so I could keep my prince
happy, but...
text_block_list.name: Каваками Принцесс

text_block_list.text: But my princessly right hand is too unruly!
text_block_list.name: Каваками Принцесс

text_block_list.text: Ahaha...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер

text_block_list.text:
But this just proves how hard you're
working to
make your dream come true.
Don't blame
yourself. Besides...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер

text_block_list.text:
I seem to remember a certain someone
stressing
the importance of working
towards something?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер

text_block_list.text: Ah!
text_block_list.name: Каваками Принцесс

text_block_list.text: The most important thing is the desire to improve yourself. It's all about working toward becoming your ideal self!
text_block_list.name: Каваками Принцесс

text_block_list.text:
If you're ever stuck in a rut, I'm certain
we can
push through it together with
guts and
determination, just like we did
with that boulder!
text_block_list.name: Каваками Принцесс

text_block_list.text:
Now's the time to show off your
princessly guts,
don't you think?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер

text_block_list.text:
Hehe... I've been out-princessed. This
gives me no
choice but to...
text_block_list.name: Каваками Принцесс

text_block_list.text: HAI...YAH!
text_block_list.name: Каваками Принцесс

text_block_list.text:
Scale any walls that get in my way! Just
like you
did before!
text_block_list.name: Каваками Принцесс

text_block_list.text:
There's no time to waste! I want to
recapture that
feeling, so I'm off to give
the punching bag a
thorough beating!
text_block_list.name: Каваками Принцесс

text_block_list.text:
Hehehe. Just like me, huh? Now that she
mentions
it...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер

text_block_list.text:
Perhaps I don't need to force myself to
change.
Because that moment already
changed me for the
better.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер

text_block_list.text:
...Looks like Kawakami helped me realize

something important yet again. I have to
work
hard to repay her!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер

text_block_list.text:
Aware of her own growth, Мэдзиро Добер
sets off
in pursuit of Каваками Принцесс.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
